description: This file defines the CatalogUrlSeoFilter class, a servlet filter overriding the doFilter method to add SEO-related URL handling logic for product catalog pages within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CatalogUrlSeoFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter extended from CatalogUrlFilter, providing SEO URL rewriting for product catalog pages.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Overrides the superclass method to set request attributes, handle URL forwarding for SEO purposes, and proceed with the filter chain.
